title: Study plan
description: Discover subjects, structure, exams, teaching approach and much more of the Master in Public Management and Policy (PMP) offered by USI.

blocks.html:
Overview

The Master’s in Public Management and Policy spans two academic years: three semesters of coursework followed by a fourth semester devoted to writing the master’s thesis and, optionally, completing a professional internship.

The curriculum (120 ECTS) is organized into three components: core courses (60 ECTS), Specialization (30 ECTS) and, research thesis (30 ECTS) or a combination of internship (10 ECTS) and thesis (20 ECTS).

In the first year, the core courses — offered mainly in Italian, but also in English — cover the following fields: political science, public management, law, public economics, and methods & interdisciplinary approaches. Within the public economics and methods & interdisciplinary modules, students may replace core courses with advanced courses taught in English.

Students are encouraged to take advantage of the PMP inter-university mobility scheme, which provides access to a wide range of specialized courses. After completing the core studies, each student selects one of the specializations offered by USI or by our partner universities in Lausanne and Bern (see below).

In accordance with the PMP regulations, students who complete one or more study blocks at a partner institution will receive their degree from the Università della Svizzera italiana, with the chosen specialization explicitly noted.

Study plan

The study plan and course descriptions provide an overview of the programme’s structure and content, and may be subject to changes.
The specialisations are presented consecutively within the same document.
Enrolled students should refer to the GESTU platform, where they can access the course offering, updated progressively each semester.

items.title: Specialisations overview
items.html:
At the end of the first year— during the third semester — students have the opportunity to choose their specialization from among the offerings of the programme’s partner universities.

Specialisation offered at USI

At USI, the available track is PUBLIC POLICY AND SUSTAINABILITY.

The Public Policy and Sustainability specialization explores how governments at various levels, public institutions and international organizations design, implement and evaluate strategies and public policies aimed at promoting long-term environmental, social and economic sustainability. The curriculum delves into approaches for joining economic growth, social equity and environmental protection, ensuring sustainable governance models capable of adapting to an ever-evolving global context. Particular emphasis is placed on adaptive governance, understood as the ability to integrate real-time feedback and recalibrate public-management and policy systems in response to ongoing changes, alongside anticipatory governance, which focuses on the use of foresight tools and strategic planning to identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities at the international, national and local levels—and to design proactive rather than merely reactive public interventions. This dual approach equips future PMP graduates with the conceptual and methodological toolkit needed to cultivate a strategic mindset, capable of addressing increasingly complex challenges—such as climate and geopolitical shifts, urbanization processes, natural-resource management and the sustainable digital transition—not only by reacting to events but by anticipating their trajectories and shaping their outcomes.

Upon completion of the programme, participants acquire advanced expertise in public-policy analysis, strategic planning and the formulation of sustainable-development strategies, preparing them for leadership roles in public administrations, international organizations, NGOs and consulting firms.

Specialisations offered in Lausanne (UNIL)

  • Public Finance and Economics
  • Transformation and Innovation in the Public Sector
  • International Governance and Public Administration

For further information: PMP UNIL.

Specialisations offered in Bern (UNIBE)

  • Öffentliches Recht – Public Law
  • Politikwissenschaft – Political Science
  • Management der öffentlichen Verwaltung - Public Management
  • Volkswirtschaftslehre – Public Economics

For further information: PMP UNIBE.

items.title: Thesis and internship
items.html:
Research thesis: 30 ECTS

The Master's thesis consists in a research work in the area of one of the different sectors of the Public Administration. The work, supervised by one or more master's professors, may focus in particular on theoretical or empirical aspects: in any case, students have to demonstrate to be able to apply appropriate concepts, methods, and tools acquired during the programme.

Internship thesis: 20 ECTS (thesis) + 10 ECTS (internship)

Students have the opportunity to combine an internship with the thesis, which has to be developed on the same subject.
An optional internship with public sector organisations or consultancy bodies is also available, allowing students to apply the knowledge acquired during the programme. The internship provides valuable experience in real-world professional settings, enabling students to further develop their skills and build a professional network.

items.title: Language
items.html:
Core courses (1st year) are taught in Italian and English, and courses of the Public Policy and Sustainability specialization (2nd year) are taught in English.
Language certificates are not required.

Università della Svizzera italiana offers free language courses in Italian, English, French and German, further information can be found here.
